name: Agency OS
purpose: A command center that turns a solo builder plus AI agents into a small accountable organization.
successDefinition: The builder can see project state, evidence gaps, blockers, agent claims and recommended next steps from one dashboard.
currentMilestone: v0.3 state synchronization and private-runtime hardening
nextAction: Define the private runtime data-home contract outside the public Git worktree.

name: ai1geo
purpose: Revenue and validation playground for AI-first operational workflows.
successDefinition: One paid or externally validated workflow proves concrete user value.
nextAction: Define one paid workflow and one proof metric.

name: OpenClaw / TeleClo
purpose: Execution and delivery infrastructure for agents, remote work and Telegram control surfaces.
successDefinition: A scoped agent can submit reviewable run events without unsafe write privileges.
nextAction: Decide the first scoped-write agent permission.

name: Lab slot
purpose: One creative game or visual experiment that stays bounded and does not compete with the core product.
successDefinition: Exactly one lab project is selected and the rest are paused.
nextAction: Choose one public-playable lab project and pause the rest.
